name: Muwaffaq
lookingFor: Senior product design roles, remote or in the Gulf
intro: I design products and build them, from the first sketch to production code. If I wouldn't open it twice, I don't ship it.

I lead design at **Nūring**, a sports-tech company that reads grip to measure effort. Alongside it, I've just launched my own app, **treeti**, for recording interest-free loans: **72 people** have joined since October. I also rebuilt **QuickPay**, a money app, on one token system.

nuring.summary: Nūring builds a smart glove that reads grip to measure effort, recovery and accumulated load, starting with baseball. I design and build across the product: the athlete app, the design system and the web.

ai: I use Claude Code to build and test real apps, and Figma MCP to set up design systems and rename hundreds of layers at once.
AI defaults to generic layouts and misses edge cases, so I set the tokens first, check every contrast pair and stress-test screens with worst-case data.

process: A 15-minute call to understand what you need
A written proposal with scope, timeline and price
Design in Figma, with your feedback at each step
Build, launch and hand over everything

how.line: Read the brief, talk to the people using it, and map every flow before drawing anything. Sarki Energy started as a 31-page sitemap from the client brief.
Study how the best products already solve the problem. For QuickPay I reviewed about 35 flows across 30+ apps.
Set the tokens and components before the screens, so every page stays consistent and dark mode or Arabic is a setting.
Loading, empty, error, pending and limit reached, not just the happy path. Then prototype the flows that matter.
Ship early and let real people shape it. treeti testers changed 8 flows within 10 days of launch.
Announce it with a launch film, then keep improving from what people actually do.
